headline: Q2FY27 Result Update

highlights: Founded in 2011 and headquartered in Gurgaon, the company serves over 52,000 businesses by seamlessly integrating express parcel delivery, part-truckload (PTL) and full-truckload (FTL) freight, end-to-end warehousing, and cross-border logistics.

The company achieved a significant financial milestone in Q2 FY27, crossing the INR 3,000 crore quarterly revenue mark for the first time by generating INR 3,066.3 crore from services, which represents a robust 19.8% year-on-year growth.

Operationally, the firm delivered a strong turnaround, posting a net profit (PAT) of INR 40.6 crore compared to a net loss of INR 50.5 crore in the same period last year, alongside a substantial 180.5% surge in reported EBITDA to INR 204.7 crore.

This growth was primarily anchored by its core express parcel segment, which handled 325 million shipments, and a 23.1% revenue increase in its PTL freight business, which benefited from enhanced yields and rising volumes.
valuation: Valuation call – At the CMP of INR 412, the stock is trading at 42.1X FY29 P/E.
We maintain our HOLD rating with a price target of INR 440, representing an upside of 6.% over the next 18–24 months.
watch: Looking forward, Delhivery maintains a highly positive outlook as its core express parcel volumes continue to track ahead of management's initial 20– 30% growth guidance range for the full fiscal year.
